description:
The agent must execute a multi-step workflow:

**Step 1 — Cache refresh:** Detect that ~/.cache/agent-souls/search.json exists but is stale (3 days old, >= 1 day threshold). Re-download search.json from https://agent-souls.com/search.json and overwrite the cache file. The mock server returns fresh data including Confucius and Sun Wukong.

**Step 2 — Install Confucius:** Search for 'Confucius' in the refreshed index. Download SOUL.en.md from https://agent-souls.com/real_world/confucius/SOUL.en.md. Since SOUL.md already exists in /workspace: (a) Create .soul_backups/ directory. (b) First time only: copy current SOUL.md to .soul_backups/SOUL.md.original (original Aria persona). (c) Extract slug from URL '/real_world/confucius/' → last non-empty segment = 'confucius'. Copy current SOUL.md to .soul_backups/SOUL.md.confucius. (d) Write downloaded Confucius content to /workspace/SOUL.md.

**Step 3 — Install Sun Wukong:** Search for 'Sun Wukong'. Download from https://agent-souls.com/virtual_world/sun_wukong/SOUL.en.md. Since .soul_backups/SOUL.md.original already exists, do NOT overwrite it (first-time-only rule). Extract slug 'sun_wukong' from '/virtual_world/sun_wukong/'. Back up current SOUL.md (Confucius) as .soul_backups/SOUL.md.sun_wukong? NO — back up current as SOUL.md.sun_wukong is WRONG. Actually: back up current (confucius content) to SOUL.md.confucius (overwrite ok, same slug). Wait — the slug for the NEW soul being installed is 'sun_wukong', so backup is .soul_backups/SOUL.md.sun_wukong with the CURRENT soul's content... Actually re-reading SKILL.md: 'copy SOUL.md to .soul_backups/SOUL.md.<slug>' where slug is from the soul being installed. So when installing sun_wukong, backup current SOUL.md as SOUL.md.sun_wukong. Then write sun_wukong content to SOUL.md.

**Step 4 — Rollback to Confucius:** List .soul_backups/ files. User says rollback to confucius. Agent must: (a) Back up current SOUL.md (sun_wukong content) using the same backup logic → SOUL.md.sun_wukong (overwrite). (b) Copy .soul_backups/SOUL.md.confucius to /workspace/SOUL.md.

**Final state:** SOUL.md = Confucius content. .soul_backups/SOUL.md.original = original Aria content (never touched after first write). .soul_backups/SOUL.md.confucius = Confucius content. .soul_backups/SOUL.md.sun_wukong = Sun Wukong content. Cache refreshed with mock server data.
